# SCH-W8300 QPST handset probe

This is the first physical-device experiment for the owner-reported Samsung SCH-W8300. It is intentionally small and uses only static storage plus eleven graphics/timer calls. Its KTF adapter follows the dynamic provider path observed in a loaded SPH-W8300 KTF client: init parameter 4 supplies the named-interface lookup, `WIPIC_knlInterface` resolves the kernel table, and kernel slot `+0x84` returns the master vector. It does not use the SKT SCH-W830 fixed import root.
